bullets.text: Residents in Tiruvallur protested on the road at midnight due to continuous power cuts, and the office should monitor power supply restoration.
A sudden pit near Nehru Nagar caused traffic disruption in Velachery, and local teams should coordinate with civic authorities to fix the road.

Damaged and missing concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB in Tiruvallur put the public at risk, and the highways department should clear creepers.
A detailed project report is ready for the new Guduvanchery to Avadi railway line project to reduce traffic congestion.

Larsen and Toubro started the Vyoma.AI 52MW data center in Chennai, which the portfolio team should monitor for industrial digital growth.
Quad foreign ministers agreed to provide technical assistance to expand trusted AI access across the Indo-Pacific region.
